description: Detection profile modeled on the UNC7017 campaign against AOMEI Backupper's update servers (GTIG + Mandiant, disclosed Oct 2026). Attackers changed the files Backupper fetches from the vendor's own update servers (down_html.ini, Notifycfg.ini) in 5-10 minute windows, May-Jul 2026, so updaters polling inside a window pulled a backdoor (CROSSROAD/SHINYROAD) while the server served genuine files almost all the time.

vendors.name: aomei-backupper
vendors.note: Poll at least every 60s: a 5-minute tamper window is invisible to hourly polling. 10-minute revert window matches the longest observed UNC7017 window.

vendors.name: aomei-anyviewer
vendors.note: GTIG named AnyViewer as using the same update flow as Backupper.
